We’re opening a research preview of Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent.

It comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf. pic.twitter.com/kt8gAbWuX8

items.text: Two employees from METR and Redwood Research worked on premises at OpenAI for three weeks this summer in an embedded assessment pilot. This team evaluated the systems OpenAI was using to monitor for misalignment from internal agents. A brief write-up of their work is now public.

cache.text: Developers use AI-based monitoring systems to catch misaligned agent behavior (e.g. when writing code or running experiments for researchers). To secure these monitoring systems, developers and assessors can look for flaws that could be exploited by agents to covertly misbehave.
